articles.title: Kirkus Reviews Praises Animal Intelligence
articles.description: Kirkus Reviews praised Animal Intelligence as “a rich and surprising alternative vision of the past” and awarded it the Get It badge, recognizing it as a standout editorial recommendation.

articles.title: Animal Intelligence Featured in The European
articles.description: The European highlighted Animal Intelligence for its imaginative approach to history, blending philosophy, illustration, and animal storytelling into a long-term, knowledge-driven project.

articles.title: Press Release: In the age of ai, animal fables and editorial cartoons return
articles.description: Student B Press has officially released a statement introducing its new title Watching Them Humans in the AI Age, along with The Book of Forgotten History, which explores the historical narratives of the animals featured in the comic.

articles.title: Comic Book featured in BookLife
articles.description: Watching Them Humans in the AI Age, set for release on May 1, has been briefly featured in the Satire & Humor category. The comic combines a cute visual style with sharp satire on society and technology.
